title: 22nd Sitting of second session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/22/2/2025).
Preliminary debate on the Bill amending the Tax Administration Act (Law No. 3/2010), submitted on behalf of the government by Vilimale MP Mohamed Ismail.
Report of the Social Affairs Committee on the Bill amending the Thalassaemia Control Act (Law No. 4/2012).
Report of the Decentralisation Committee on the Bill amending the Decentralisation Act (Law No. 7/2010).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting opened debate on the Tax Administration Act amendment and took up committee reports on the Thalassaemia Control Act and Decentralisation Act amendments.
